units.source_text: 這樣越想疑惑越深，但我沒有當面盤問她的勇氣，

en.t: The more I thought about it, the deeper my doubts became, but I did not have the courage to question her face to face,

units.source_text: 只能被以往的不安和恐懼所折磨，只有在喝醉之後，才敢縮手縮腳地試著以卑屈的誘導方式詢問幾句。

en.t: and could only be tormented by the old uneasiness and fear; only after getting drunk did I dare, timidly and obsequiously, to try asking a few leading questions.

units.source_text: 心中雖喜憂參半，表面上卻裝出拼命搞笑的樣子，

en.t: Though inwardly I swung between relief and anxiety, on the surface I put on an act of desperately playing the clown,

units.source_text: 然後，對良子施以地獄般令人作嘔的愛撫，如同一堆爛泥一樣睡去。

en.t: and then subjected Yoshiko to hellish, nauseating caresses, before falling asleep like a lump of mud.

units.source_text: 那一年年末，我喝得酩酊大醉，半夜三更回到家，想喝一杯糖水，

en.t: At the end of that year, I came home very late at night dead drunk and wanted to drink a cup of sugar water,

units.source_text: 見良子已經熟睡，自己便到廚房找糖罐，

en.t: and seeing that Yoshiko was already sound asleep, I went to the kitchen myself to look for the sugar jar,

units.source_text: 找出來開啟蓋子一看，一點砂糖都沒有，

en.t: but when I found it and opened the lid, there was not a grain of sugar inside,

units.source_text: 只有一個黑長的紙盒，我隨手取出來，

en.t: only a long black paper box, which I casually took out,

units.source_text: 看了看貼在盒子上的標籤，頓時一陣愕然。

en.t: and when I looked at the label pasted on it, I was suddenly stunned.
